limitations: R13 evidence proves the behavior exercised by the exact checkpointed Debug XCTest inventory; it separately proves build and archive identity, not execution, of the exact clean Release app.
Automated Debug XCTest executed the genuine MPS Lanczos A11 backend for both product routes; this is functional execution, not GPU profiling or hardware qualification.
Release-candidate GPU execution, GPU profiling, hardware qualification, simulator, Instruments, and operator observations are not_observed and are nonblocking.
No comparative, historical-comparison, or A/B result is required or used.
Auto is unavailable and not_authorized, model acquisition is not_required, and no fallback route is accepted.
This acceptance authorizes a release-ready candidate outcome; it does not authorize a tag, release publication, product publication, or market claim.
The available Release toolchain build excludes Metal source files; the candidate contains no default.metallib and makes no Release-candidate GPU execution claim.

The retained MOV is produced by Debug XCTest through the genuine default A11 MPS Lanczos backend and AVFoundation media pipeline, with a deterministic test-scoped release environment; the separately built Release app did not produce that output and its execution was not observed.
Distribution signing identity, notarization, Gatekeeper, launch smoke, and Release-app execution were not observed; distribution, notarized, and distributable claims are not authorized.
